definitions.explanation: Having or displaying a commanding, awe-inspiring, and dignified presence. A four-character idiom ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) describing someone or something that exudes authority and magnificence.

examples.japanese: {威風堂々|いふうどうどう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: To walk with dignity and grandeur.

examples.japanese: {威風堂々|いふうどうどう}とした⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{演説|えんぜつ}→演説：01894_enzetsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He gave the speech with an imposing demeanor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{威風堂々|いふうどうどう}たる⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦そびえている→そびえる：10360_sobieru⟧。
examples.english: The castle stands majestically atop the mountain.

notes:
A ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧ (four-character idiom) composed of ⟦{威風|いふう}→威風：09176_ifuu⟧ (dignified air, majesty) + ⟦{堂々|どうどう}→堂々：05895_doudou⟧ (grand, imposing). Describes a powerful, awe-inspiring presence.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{威|い}→威：28463_i⟧ (authority) + {風|ふう} (manner) + {堂|どう} (stately) + {堂|どう} (stately) — "an authoritative manner, grandly stately."

USAGE:
- As an adverb: {威風堂々|いふうどうどう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ + verb
- As a modifier: {威風堂々|いふうどうどう}とした + noun / {威風堂々|いふうどうどう}たる + noun

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {威風堂々|いふうどうどう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧: to assume a dignified stance
- {威風堂々|いふうどうどう}とした⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: a majestic figure
- {威風堂々|いふうどうどう}たる⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: an imposing attitude

CULTURAL NOTE:
Also the Japanese title of Edward Elgar's famous march "Pomp and Circumstance" ({威風堂々|いふうどうどう}), well known in Japan as a graduation ceremony piece.
